title: 85 South: Ghetto Legends
overview: DC Young Fly, Karlous Miller and Chico Bean bring their famous podcast to the stage to create a unique comedy special where nothing and no one is safe from their jokes.

title: Andrew Schulz: LIFE
overview: In this razor-sharp yet heartfelt special, Andrew Schulz unpacks the wildest moment of his life — becoming a father.

title: Beyond Stranger Things
overview: Secrets from the "Stranger Things 2" universe are revealed as cast and guests discuss the latest episodes with host Jim Rash. Caution: spoilers ahead!

title: Bill Burr: I'm Sorry You Feel That Way
overview: Fresh, unflinching and devastatingly honest, Bill Burr lets loose in this feature length comedy special. Burr shares his essential tips for surviving the zombie apocalypse, exposes how rom-coms ruin great sex and explains how too many childhood hugs may be the ultimate downfall of man.

title: Chris Rock: Selective Outrage
overview: Chris Rock delivers an electric stand-up set on non-racist yoga pants, spoiling his kids, the Kardashians and his thoughts on the Will Smith fiasco.

title: Chris Tucker: Live
overview: Comedian Chris Tucker performs live.

title: Dave Chappelle
overview: Comedy icon Dave Chappelle makes his triumphant return to the screen with a pair of blistering, fresh stand-up specials.

title: Dave Chappelle: Equanimity & The Bird Revelation
overview: Comedy titan Dave Chappelle caps a wild year with two stand-up specials packed with scorching new material, self-reflection and tough love.

title: Dave Chappelle: Sticks & Stones
overview: Dave Chappelle takes on gun culture, the opioid crisis and the tidal wave of celebrity scandals in this defiant stand-up special.

title: Dave Chappelle: The Closer
overview: As he closes out his slate of comedy specials, Dave takes the stage to try and set the record straight — and get a few things off his chest.

title: Stavros Halkias: Fat Rascal
overview: A snapshot of a man whose many vices are actively getting the best of him and a collection of observations, interesting experiences, and sexual embarrassments from two years of non-stop touring

title: Trevor Noah: Lost In Translation
overview: Filmed at The Lincoln Theatre in Washington, D.C., "Trevor Noah: Lost in Translation" brings Noah's unique world-view and global analysis of American culture to the forefront. In the special, Noah addresses major domestic and international events of the past year, sharing his outlook on the world today, including terrorism, racial tensions in America and what it was like being African and travelling into the United States during the EBOLA crisis.

title: Trevor Noah: Where Was I
overview: Trevor Noah riffs on national anthems, derailing a German sightseeing tour and getting roasted in Paris in this comedy special about his world travels.

title: Ali Wong: Baby Cobra
overview: Ali Wong might be seven-months pregnant, but there’s not a fetus in the world that can stop this acerbic and savage train of comedy from delivering a masterful hour of stand-up.

title: Anthony Jeselnik: Bones and All
overview: Anthony Jeselnik celebrates 20 years of delivering boundary-pushing comedy to the masses in this razor-sharp stand-up special.

title: Bert Kreischer: Lucky
overview: Losing 45 pounds. Getting parenting advice from Snoop Dogg. Bert Kreischer knows he's the luckiest guy around — and he's recounting his blessings.

title: Bert Kreischer: Razzle Dazzle
overview: Shameless — and shirtless — as ever, Bert spills on bodily emissions, being bullied by his kids and the explosive end to his family's escape room outing.

title: Bill Burr: Live at Red Rocks
overview: Comedian Bill Burr sounds off on cancel culture, feminism, getting bad reviews from his wife and a life-changing epiphany during a fiery stand-up set.

title: Bill Burr: Paper Tiger
overview: Comedian Bill Burr talks male feminists, outrage culture, robot sex, and cultural appropriation in this standup comedy special shot in London.

title: Bo Burnham: Make Happy
overview: Combining his trademark wit and self-deprecating humor with original music, Bo Burnham offers up his unique twist on life in this stand-up special about  life, death, sexuality, hypocrisy, mental illness and Pringles cans.

title: Bruce Bruce: I Ain't Playin'
overview: Bruce Bruce returns after 14 years with his Netflix debut "I Ain't Playin'" - observing generational chaos and life's craziness through personal stories.

title: CMXXIV
overview: Turkish comedy heavyweight Cem Yılmaz takes the stand-up stage in this dynamic special – covering everything from cancel culture to regretful tattoos.

title: Comedians in Cars Getting Coffee
overview: Jerry takes his comedy pals out for coffee in a selection of his classic automobiles. Larry David sums it up best when he says, 'You've finally made a show about nothing.'

title: Cristela Alonzo: Upper Classy
overview: Cristela seeks joy through various experiences - outdoing her old bully, overdoing spa treatments, and taking her first family vacation - while teaching everyone to embrace life's pleasures.

title: Daniel Sloss: Live Shows
overview: Comedian Daniel Sloss is ready to find the funny in some very dark topics, from the deeply personal to the truly irreverent.

title: Earthquake: Joke Telling Business
overview: From unpacking celebrity scandals to hot takes on love, legendary comic Earthquake shakes things up in this explosive stand-up set.

title: Fortune Feimster: Crushing It
overview: From no longer being her mom's stand-in husband to a "romantic" honeymoon with her wife, Fortune Feimster is crushing it in this feel-good special.

title: Franco Escamilla: bienvenido al mundo
overview: Comedian Franco Escamilla shares stories about parenting his children when they get into trouble, with reflections on gender, friendship and romance.

title: Franco Escamilla: por la anécdota
overview: Mexican stand-up comedian Franco Escamilla draws his jokes from real-life experiences -- and he's willing to do anything for new material. He's not afraid to make generalizations about how men bathe. But he is scared to talk to strangers. Especially at funerals.

title: Gad Elmaleh: American Dream
overview: In his first English-language special, comedian Gad Elmaleh gleefully digs into America's food obsessions, dating culture, slang, and more.

title: George Lopez: Why You Crying?
overview: Stand-up comic George Lopez uses his childhood experiences growing up Latino in the San Fernando Valley as a platform for nonstop humor. The funnyman takes you on a liberating journey as he hysterically dissects his life growing up in Los Angeles. Reminiscing about the unique quirks in Mexican culture, George tackles such topics as family relationships, insecurities, sexuality, drinking and language.

title: Hasan Minhaj: Off with His Head
overview: Hasan Minhaj delivers an unapologetic stand-up set about midlife identity struggles, race relations, political divides — and that fact-checking scandal.

title: Jamie Foxx: What Had Happened Was...
overview: Oscar- and Golden Globe-winning actor. Grammy-winning singer. Beloved comedian. Jamie Foxx returns to the stage to set the record straight.

title: Jo Koy: Live from Brooklyn
overview: In this unfiltered stand-up special, comedian Jo Koy takes on energy vampires, mumble rap, emoji flirting and the surprise of being called a zaddy.

title: Joe DeRosa: I Never Promised You a Rose Garden
overview: "I Never Promised You A Rose Garden" is an all-new hour of hopeless comedy derived from the troubled mind of Joe DeRosa. Celebrating pure evil, abandonment, and societal collapse, Joe’s bleak outlook on society will actually bring you joy in this dire climate.

title: John Mulaney: Baby J
overview: A chaotic intervention. An action-packed stay in rehab. After a weird couple of years, John Mulaney comes out swinging in his return to the stage.

title: John Mulaney: Kid Gorgeous at Radio City
overview: John Mulaney relays stories from his childhood and "SNL," eviscerates the value of college and laments getting older in this electric comedy special.

title: Katt Williams: Great America
overview: The king of underground comedy takes the stage in Jacksonville with unflinching riffs on American politics and the raunchy perils of getting old.

title: Katt Williams: World War III
overview: Katt Williams riffs on truth, lies, chicken wing shortages and the war on drugs in this electrifying stand-up special filmed in Las Vegas.

title: Leanne Morgan: I'm Every Woman
overview: Morgan showcases her life via intimate tales about her upbringing in a small town in Tennessee, her almost 20 years of marriage, the challenges of parenting her three children, and her first experience as a grandmother.

title: Live from the Other Side with Tyler Henry
overview: World-renowned medium Tyler Henry gives celebrity guests hope, healing and long-sought answers through emotional readings.

title: Martin Matte : La vie, la mort... eh la la..!
overview: Quebecois comedy star Martin Matte serves up embarrassing personal stories, a solution for social media trolls and more in this unpredictable special.

title: Mike Epps: Ready to Sell Out
overview: Mike Epps keeps it real as he riffs on poor personal hygiene, failing at infidelity and waging war on work husbands in this stand-up comedy special.

title: Mo Amer: Wild World
overview: In this fearlessly honest special, Mo Amer honors his Palestinian roots, recounts confrontations on the road and relives becoming a father.

title: Nate Bargatze: The Greatest Average American
overview: Nate Bargatze touches on Zoom comedy shows, losing his phone, hotel breakfast fails, animal caddies, new math and much more in this special.

title: Nate Bargatze: The Tennessee Kid
overview: Comic Nate Bargatze touches on air travel, cheap weddings, college football, chocolate milk and the perils of ordering coffee in this stand-up special.

title: Nimesh Patel: Buy The Dip
overview: In his first Netflix special, Nimesh Patel talks rebelling against his traditional parents and why you should never go viral in India.

title: Ricardo Quevedo: Hay gente así
overview: Droll comic Ricardo Quevedo hits Bogotá with a set that touches on embarrassing misunderstandings, sex talk, the thrill of being scared and more.

title: Ricardo Quevedo: Tomorrow Will Be Worse
overview: From road rage to couples fighting during the pandemic, comic Ricardo Quevedo examines the absurdity of the situations that try our patience.

title: Ricky Gervais: Mortality
overview: Ricky Gervais tackles life, death and the state of the world in a brutally honest special that spares no topic, even his own mortality.

title: Ron White: If You Quit Listening, I'll Shut Up
overview: Ron "Tater Salad" White dishes out his signature brand of cynicism, riffing on sex, celebrity and the sinister habits of wild geese.

title: Ronny Chieng: Love to Hate It
overview: Ronny Chieng unpacks fertility treatment fiascoes, the dark side of men's self-help and scam-sensitive parents.

title: Rory Scovel: Show Must Go On
overview: With a hypothetical home invasion, a biblical reenactment, and his late dad's final wish, Rory Scovel delivers unrelenting laughs in this raucous stand-up special filmed at The Neptune in Seattle, Washington.

title: Sarah Millican: Late Bloomer
overview: When Sarah Millican was a bairn, she wouldn't say boo to a goose. Quiet at school, not many friends, no boobs 'til she was 16. Now? NOW she is loud, with good friends, a cracking rack and goose booing all over the shop. In Sarah's seventh stand-up special, she explores how one became the other. Plus, lots of stuff about dinners and lady gardens.

title: Sheng Wang: Purple
overview: Sheng Wang shares his thoughts on edible bras, braving the ghosts in your house and guarding expensive berries from your friends' kids.

title: Sofía Niño de Rivera: Natural Selection
overview: If it were up to this Mexican comedian, marriage proposals would occur in the middle of a couple's biggest argument.

title: Stamptown
overview: Blending the wild worlds of circus and comedy, anarchic acts collide for this raunchy and explicit variety show - clothing not guaranteed.

title: The Founder5 II: Unfinished Business
overview: Grander, bolder and sharper, the Founder5 returns to the stage with other talented comedians for more standup, improv and sketch comedy.

title: Trevor Noah: I Wish You Would
overview: Emmy-winning comedian Trevor Noah talks learning German, speaking ill of the dead, judging people in horror movies and ordering Indian food in Scotland.

title: Trevor Noah: Son of Patricia
overview: Trevor Noah gets out from behind the "Daily Show" desk and takes the stage for a stand-up special that touches on racism, immigration, camping and more.

title: My Next Guest Needs No Introduction with David Letterman
overview: Late-night TV legend David Letterman hosts an intimate talk show featuring insightful conversations and fun-filled excursions with notable figures.
